first.rationale: Verify the two most decision-relevant onboarding and activation beliefs because both metrics are currently declining and simplification could improve qualified revenue through faster time-to-value. Use a guarded test to monitor completion, activation, qualification, retention proxies, and downstream revenue while limiting the risk that removing signup fields reduces lead quality. Promotional pricing remains an unverified alternative but may trade sustainable value for short-term acquisition.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on self-serve SMB accounts. The verified evidence directly addresses both declining metrics: shortened onboarding increased completion, reduced time-to-value, and improved retention, while signup simplification increased activation and qualified revenue. Monitor qualified revenue, retention, lead quality, and segment differences because the signup result included a small retention decline and has not been validated beyond SMB.
